# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the root of this repository: it is the one guide for every coding agent working on napoland (commands, rules, play-testing, pull requests and hard limits). Read it before you change anything.

In short: run `npm run check` before every push, tests come with changes, never deploy or touch production, and say in the pull request which parts an AI wrote.
